charges.label: Base freight (per km by billed weight band)
charges.quote: up to and including 500 kg: ₹18.00 per km; 501 kg to 2,000 kg: ₹24.00 per km. Consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside this rate card.

charges.label: Express service premium (15% of base freight)
charges.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

charges.label: Fuel surcharge (12% of base freight plus express premium)
charges.quote: A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

charges.label: Residential delivery (flat per consignment)
charges.quote: Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): ₹250.00 flat per consignment.

document_rules.rule: Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; a credit note references the original consignment note number and states the invoice it corrects.
Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date; disputed line items are payable only on resolution, undisputed items remain due.
Carrier invoices fortnightly; payment is due 30 days from invoice date.
Any service outside the schedule requires the Customer's written agreement in advance, evidenced by a rate confirmation referencing this agreement.

ambiguities.description: Weight bands are 'up to and including 500 kg' and '501 kg to 2,000 kg'; a billed weight strictly between 500 and 501 kg (e.g. 500.4 kg) is not covered by either band, so base freight (and the fuel surcharge / express premium derived from it) is undetermined.

The residential charge also applies when the consignee address is a residence even if the booking is not flagged residential; the shipment record exposes only the 'residential' special_handling flag, so an unflagged delivery to a residence cannot be identified from the available fields. Encoded as applying when special_handling contains 'residential'.

notes: No minimum weight or chargeable-weight rule in the contract; base freight tiers on billed_weight_kg directly. Fuel surcharge applies only to base freight + express premium, not to the residential charge. No invoice-level discounts. Cold_chain and fragile have no listed charge and are not payable under the closed list (§5).
